steps.evidence: wbs=0001 status=todo tags=fleet:auto feature=A readiness=task check --as wip PASS

steps.assertion: the planner and coder loops attach: a live orchestrator claim and a recorded fleet member session, with the stub first on PATH
steps.evidence: pids=16404,16405 (stub first on PATH) orchestrator claim live member session recorded

steps.command: spur task show 0001 --json (poll) + spur message inbox --agent spur-fleet-e2e-1793060620701-coder-1 --json

steps.assertion: an operator 'status?' message to the orchestrator is drained by the orchestrator loop and answered in the operator inbox

steps.command: kill -KILL <coder loop>; restart spur agent loop --spec spur-fleet-e2e-1793060620701-coder-1 (no operator dispatch, no planner nudge)
steps.assertion: an unkeyed stdin delivery with no run row never holds dispatch; the hang task is dispatched as fleet:task:<wbs>:1 by the strategy alone (no operator message, no planner nudge); the coder loop is SIGKILLed mid-turn; the restarted loop finalizes the orphaned run errored before its first drain; and the strategy re-dispatches fleet:task:<wbs>:2 on its own

steps.assertion: a joined guest occupant (agent join --role) pulls a dispatched review request through agent wait --inbox and its reply lands in the operator inbox
spur agent trace resolves the execution record of the dispatched turn: an agent node whose durable stream exists with content, over a loop-free lineage

residualRisks.summary: A strategy dispatch records no parent run edge, so its execution record is a single-node lineage: the dispatch → member-turn depth of 2 requires the workflow dispatcher.
residualRisks.rootCause: drainIntoPrompt sets parentRunId only from a workflow request key of the shape `<runId>/<state>` (apps/cli/src/commands/agent/shared.ts:449); the strategy's `fleet:task:<wbs>:<n>` key is deliberately excluded, so the member turn is a lineage root (packages/app/src/services/agent-run-executor.ts:364).
residualRisks.evidence: the traced dispatch run reports parentRunId=null and nodes.length=1; its stream and status are still readable, which is what the step asserts.
